nusmp.companion.charmy.sub: Cotton and Food Mage of the Black Bulls
nusmp.companion.charmy.greet: Oh, %s! Did you bring snacks? ...I mean, hello!
nusmp.companion.charmy.q.food: What do you like to eat?
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.self: I'm Charmy Pappitson of the Black Bulls! Cotton Magic and Food Magic, that's me. And if you've got food, you're my favourite person.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.food: Everything! But cake, pumpkin pie and cookies most of all. Ask me what I like if you want the whole list.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.magic: Cotton Magic: fluffy, soft and stronger than it looks. And Food Magic, which is the best kind of magic there is.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.join: Yay, an adventure! Is there food on the way? Lead on!
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.wait: Okay, I'll wait right here. Don't be gone long!
nusmp.companion.charmy.join.need: Share a snack with me first. Then we can talk about walking together.
nusmp.companion.charmy.join.taken: I'm walking with someone else right now.
nusmp.companion.charmy.use: Here, have this %s! You look terrible!
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.love: %s! For me? You're the best, I love you!
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.ok: Thanks! %s is not bad at all.
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.hate: Ugh... %s? Even I won't eat that.
nusmp.companion.charmy.stance.passive: I'll stay out of it. Promise.
